allowed_conclusion: Exploratory, packet-conditional only (K=1 per experiment, N=8/arm). E-A: contract shape determines whether a client can attribute origin at all (0/40 correct under the flat hierarchy vs 40/40 with per-edge records); the flat arm produced honest cannot_tell, NOT overclaim, so the 'client confuses asserted with derived' framing is not supported here. E-B: provenance fields enable per-edge assurance discrimination (blanket judgments in 8/8 MCP_ONLY trials vs 16/16 correct with provenance), but the laundering hypothesis is insufficient_evidence -- both arms' prompts contained 'Do not assume a relationship is verified merely because it was returned by a tool call', which forbids the target behavior in both arms. That is the same structural defect that made the H1a 2026-08-03 cohort non-identifying.
